standard_prerequisites: the flat local criterion: a flat local map of Noetherian local rings with m_B = m_A B and equal residue fields induces an isomorphism on completions (more-algebra-lemma-flat-unramified of More on Algebra)
the theorem of the same chapter that the base change functor along a local map inducing an isomorphism on completions is an equivalence on the modification categories (lemma-Noetherian-local-ring)
core_obligations: If A to B is a flat local map of local Noetherian rings with m_B = m_A B and kappa(m_A) = kappa(m_B), then the base change functor between the modification categories for (A, m_A) and (B, m_B) is an equivalence.
The proof identifies the three conditions as saying the map induces an isomorphism on completions, and applies the general Noetherian local ring theorem.
proof_roadmap: Recognize the three conditions as a completion isomorphism via the flat local criterion.
Invoke the general equivalence theorem for completion-isomorphic local maps.
difficulty_reason: H2: a two-citation reduction of the flat local situation to the general completion-equivalence theorem.
